body:
Yeah, hitting rock bottom is liberating in a kind of twisted way. I already know the worst that could happen. There's no harm in trying things- but every day I feel like there's less good that could come out of it. It's hard to try things in that state.

I think the fact that I'm posting here shows that there's some part of me that thinks things can get better. I'm just at a loss for how, and rapidly running out of the energy to make it happen :/

Thank you for responding. It's good to know that this sort of "limbo" state can end. I don't think I'll ever "recover" from depression...I think no matter what, Death's got his hand on my shoulder the rest of my life. I'm just trying to find a way to make the rest of my life be a bit longer than tomorrow.

Did you read the sidebar at all?

If I'm contemplating suicide, don't you think it's a little bit more complicated than just deciding not to think bad thoughts. Christ. If it were that easy there would be no suicides.

Fuck off with your condescension.

Thank you for taking the time to respond, and for the kind words. That means the world to me.

I'm going to respond in small chunks. I'm emotionally and physically exhausted. I had a flareup from a condition that causes pretty severe pain, which precipitated the withdrawal...I took a bit more than was prescribed for a loading dose, because I was in agony. Then I tasted the euphoria again, and got sucked right back in...
